title: Trans enantiomeric separation of MESA and MOXA, two environmentally important metabolites of the herbicide, metolachlor
author: Bianca, Rice, et al.

steps.title: Collect water sample
steps.instruction: Collect 1 L of water from the field site for analysis.

steps.title: Filter sample
steps.instruction: Pass the 1 L water through a 0.7 µm GF/F filter to remove particulates.

steps.title: Solid‑phase extraction (SPE)
steps.instruction: Extract MESA and MOXA from the filtered water using an Oasis HLB SPE cartridge (500 mg).

substeps.instruction: Elute the cartridge with 12 mL methanol.

steps.title: Concentrate eluate
steps.instruction: Evaporate the combined eluate under a gentle nitrogen stream until the volume is reduced to either 5 mL or 10 mL, as required.

steps.title: Adjust final volume
steps.instruction: Adjust the concentrated extract volume (by dilution or further concentration) so that integrated analyte peaks will fall within the method’s limits of detection.
